_comment: Readable documents. memory: recovering it gives Kurt a memory point. clue: recorded in the story ledger as clue.read:<id>. All text is proposed environmental storytelling.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.text:
KURSK 0931
TO K FEDEROV KERZHANSK POSTE RESTANTE

NO WORD FROM MARTA EIGHT DAYS STOP FLAT 47 BUILDING 14 GAGARINA STOP PLEASE CHECK ON HER STOP MONEY SENT STOP SHE WILL NOT WANT TO SEE YOU STOP GO ANYWAY

evacuation.title: Notice (on the hallway wall)
evacuation.text:
CITY ADMINISTRATION OF KERZHANSK

Residents of the Plant No. 3 district are to assemble in the school yard at 06:00 on 15 October with one bag per person. Buses will be provided.

As a precaution, tap water is not to be drunk. Do not go down to the basements.

This measure is temporary.

fridge_note.title: Note on the fridge
fridge_note.text:
Milk. Bread. Candles (lots).
Phone Galya about the boxes.
DON'T LET HER IN THE BOX ROOM.

— underneath, in different ink, pressed hard:
they are only boxes

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.text: October 1996. Every day is crossed through, firmly, up to the 14th. After that the crosses are lighter, and then they are not crosses but little squares. Inside each square, a smaller square.

photo_cut.title: Photograph
photo_cut.text: A woman in a good coat, laughing on a pier. Marta, younger. Beside her someone has been cut out of the photograph with nail scissors, very carefully, all the way round, so that only his hand is left on her shoulder.

clipping.title: Newspaper clipping
clipping.text:
Yellow, folded small, kept in a jewellery box.

'...TRICKSHOT TURNS THE TABLES — the Champions' League marksman ended the three-day siege at the Palace of Culture without a single...'

The photograph has been torn away. Someone has written in the margin, in Marta's hand: you never could stay.

drawing.title: Child's drawing
drawing.text: Crayon. A tall flat block with every window coloured in. In one window, a woman and a girl. Over the roof there's a big square with a smaller square inside it, and inside that, another. The girl has written her name in the corner but the paper's torn there.

diary_page.title: Torn page
diary_page.text:
...they talk all night in the walls now, the clicking, I think it's a language. I am starting to understand it and I wish I wasn't. It says the boxes are doors. It says everyone gets a box. It says the little one has to go first because she's smallest...

(the rest is scribbled through until the paper tore)

letter_returned.title: Returned letter
letter_returned.text: An envelope addressed in Marta's handwriting to a post box number with no name. RETURN TO SENDER, stamped three times. Inside, one line: 'She asks about you. I tell her you were a magician.'

boxes_label.title: Label on a box
boxes_label.text:
SONYA — WINTER
(in a different hand:) inside

fuse_card.title: Card inside the fuse box
fuse_card.text:
A — HALL / KITCHEN
B — ROOMS
C — BATH
spare fuses: kitchen drawer

backrooms_note.title: Note, pinned to a door
backrooms_note.text:
It's the same flat. Don't believe it when it's not.
She can't see in the dark any better than you.
She hates the music box. No — she LOVES it. It makes her stop.

backrooms_note2.title: Note in pencil, on the wall
backrooms_note2.text:
13. GROUND FLOOR.
THE CARETAKER CAN'T SEE. HE HEARS.
KEY IN THE MAILBOX. OR ON HIS BOARD.
(arrows, many of them, pointing down)

plank_note.title: Chalk on the balcony
plank_note.text:
48's balcony is ONE plank away.
Don't look down. There isn't a down.

scrawl_13.title: On the wall
scrawl_13.text:
13

GROUND FLOOR
GO DOWN
SHE'S WAITING IN 13

(the same number, over and over, smaller and smaller, down to the skirting board)

building_notice.title: Notice (vestibule)
building_notice.text:
BUILDING 14 — CARETAKER
Ring at the lodge for keys.
Do not disturb the caretaker after 22:00.
The caretaker is always here.
